thread.title: Apple (AAPL) Given a $200.00 Price Target at Rosenblatt Securities

author: Max Byerly
title: Apple (AAPL) Given a $200.00 Price Target at Rosenblatt Securities
text:
Rosenblatt Securities set a $200.00 price objective on Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) in a report issued on Monday. The firm currently has a buy rating on the iPhone maker’s stock.
Several other equities research analysts also recently issued reports on the company. Sanford C. Bernstein reiterated a neutral rating and set a $200.00 price target on shares of Apple in a report on Monday. Wedbush began coverage on Apple in a report on Thursday, October 18th. They set an outperform rating and a $310.00 price target for the company. JPMorgan Chase & Co. reiterated a buy rating and set a $272.00 price target on shares of Apple in a report on Wednesday, October 10th. Bank of America reiterated a buy rating on shares of Apple in a report on Tuesday, October 9th. Finally, Vertical Group began coverage on Apple in a report on Tuesday, October 9th. They set a sell rating for the company. Three equities research sell rating, nineteen have given a hold rating and thirty have given a buy rating to the stock. The company has a consensus rating of Buy and a consensus price target of $224.63.
Get Apple alerts: Shares of Apple stock opened at $220.65 on Monday. Apple has a 12-month low of $150.24 and a 12-month high of $233.47. The firm has a market cap of $1,077.94 billion, a P/E ratio of 23.96, a P/E/G ratio of 1.68 and a beta of 1.36. The company has a quick ratio of 1.24, a current ratio of 1.31 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.84.
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last announced its quarterly earnings results on Tuesday, July 31st. The iPhone maker reported $2.34 earnings per share (EPS) for the quarter, topping the Thomson Reuters’ consensus estimate of $2.18 by $0.16. Apple had a return on equity of 43.50% and a net margin of 21.98%. The business had revenue of $53.27 billion during the quarter, compared to the consensus estimate of $52.43 billion. During the same quarter in the prior year, the company posted $1.67 earnings per share. Apple’s revenue was up 17.3% compared to the same quarter last year. On average, equities analysts anticipate that Apple will post 11.76 EPS for the current year.
In other Apple news, CEO Timothy D. Cook sold 265,160 shares of the firm’s stock in a transaction dated Monday, August 27th. The stock was sold at an average price of $217.79, for a total value of $57,749,196.40. The transaction was disclosed in a legal filing with the SEC, which is accessible through this hyperlink . Also, insider Johny Srouji sold 14,140 shares of the firm’s stock in a transaction dated Friday, August 17th. The shares were sold at an average price of $214.98, for a total value of $3,039,817.20. Following the completion of the sale, the insider now directly owns 68,302 shares in the company, valued at approximately $14,683,563.96. The disclosure for this sale can be found here . In the last ninety days, insiders sold 564,185 shares of company stock worth $124,444,213. Insiders own 0.06%
Several large investors have recently added to or reduced their stakes in the business. River Wealth Advisors LLC increased its position in shares of Apple by 1.4% during the 1st quarter. River Wealth Advisors LLC now owns 40,153 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $6,737,000 after purchasing an additional 563 shares during the last quarter. Inverness Counsel LLC NY increased its position in shares of Apple by 29.3% during the 1st quarter. Inverness Counsel LLC NY now owns 217,412 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $36,477,000 after purchasing an additional 49,273 shares during the last quarter. Dean Capital Investments Management LLC bought a new position in Apple during the 1st quarter worth approximately $1,025,000. West Branch Capital LLC purchased a new stake in Apple in the 1st quarter worth approximately $5,939,000. Finally, Mirador Capital Partners LP lifted its holdings in Apple by 34.6% in the 1st quarter. Mirador Capital Partners LP now owns 36,703 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $6,066,000 after buying an additional 9,438 shares during the period. 58.51% of the stock is currently owned by hedge funds and other institutional investors.
Apple Company Profile
Apple Inc designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, and personal computers to consumers, and small and mid-sized businesses; and education, enterprise, and government customers worldwide. The company also sells related software, services, accessories, networking solutions, and third-party digital content and applications.
